newsitem.title: USA: FTC requests merger data from Mediq.
newsitem.headline: FTC requests merger data from Mediq.

text.p: MEDIQ Inc and Universal Hospital Services Inc said on Thursday that the U.S. Federal Trade Commission (FTC) requested more information about MEDIQ's plan to acquire Universal for $17.50 a share.
The request extends the waiting period for the Hart-Scott-Rodino Antitrust Improvements ACT, which is the time period for the agency to review the deal, the companies said.
The companies said they intend to comply with the FTC's request and to close the deal as soon as possible, if the FTC approves the deal.
Mediq and Universal Hospital said the waiting period was scheduled to expire April 10.
Universal Hospital shareholders approved the deal on April 4, 1997, the companies said.
